content.short: Status.IM is a messaging app, wallet, and Web3 browser with a strong emphasis on security.
content.description: Status.IM uses advanced security-focused design to keep its features secure and encrypted. It includes a secure messaging app, a crypto wallet, and a Web3 browser that rely on end-to-end encryption and an open-source, peer-to-peer protocol to protect messages and user privacy. Status.IM also provides access to a growing ecosystem of decentralized apps, including social networks, marketplaces, games, and exchanges, all within a single experience.
content.meta: Status.IM is a secure messaging app, wallet, and Web3 browser. Discover Status.IM and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
